title: Extension Fee Method by Recent Payments (Kestrel New Vehicle Retail)
content:
**Hardship desk schedule — Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.** The way the tier's extension fee is figured depends on what the customer has paid on the contract in the past month.

**Rule.** The recent payments are the payments posted on the contract after the same day of the previous calendar month. When the recent payments reach at least one monthly payment, the tier's extension fee is halved and the result rounded down to the whole dollar; when they reach at least half of one monthly payment but less than one monthly payment, the tier's extension fee is multiplied by three quarters and the result rounded down to the whole dollar; in every other case the tier's extension fee is used as it stands.

**Records and counting.** The recent payments are the total of the payment entries on the contract's ledger dated within the last 1 calendar month, today included. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.

| Recent payments compared with one monthly payment | Tier's extension fee becomes |
|---|---|
| at least one monthly payment | half, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| at least half, but less than one monthly payment | three quarters, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| less than half | unchanged |

## Worked cases (hypothetical inputs)

Monthly payment 480.00 dollars; a tier extension fee taken, for illustration, as 45.00 dollars.

- Recent payments 480.00 dollars: half of 45.00 is 22.50, rounded down to 22.00 dollars.
- Recent payments 240.00 dollars (exactly half): three quarters of 45.00 is 33.75, rounded down to 33.00 dollars.
- Recent payments 239.99 dollars: 45.00 dollars as it stands.
- Today the 12th: a payment dated the 13th of the previous month counts; one dated the 12th of the previous month does not.
